zechariah.1.p1.b1.text: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius

zechariah.1.p1.b2.text: the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying

zechariah.1.p1.b3.text: “The LORD was very angry with your fathers.

zechariah.1.p1.b4.text: Return to Me … and I will return to you, says the LORD of Hosts

zechariah.1.p1.b5.text: the former prophets proclaimed that this is what the LORD of Hosts says … Turn now from your evil ways and deeds. … But they did not listen or pay attention to Me

zechariah.1.p1.b6.text: Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?

zechariah.1.p1.b7.text: But did not My words and My statutes … overtake your fathers?

zechariah.1.p1.b8.text: Just as the LORD of Hosts purposed to do to us according to our ways and deeds, so He has done to us.

zechariah.1.p2.b1.text: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius

zechariah.1.p2.b2.text: I looked out into the night and saw a man riding on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in the hollow, and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.

zechariah.1.p2.b4.text: We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and tranquil.

zechariah.1.p2.b5.text: How long, O LORD of Hosts, will You withhold mercy from Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which You have been angry these seventy years?

zechariah.1.p2.b6.text: I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there My house will be rebuilt … and a measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.

zechariah.1.p2.b7.text: My cities will again overflow with prosperity; the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.

zechariah.1.p3.b1.text: Then I looked up and saw four horns.

zechariah.1.p3.b3.text: These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

zechariah.1.p3.b4.text: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

zechariah.1.p3.b5.text: What are these coming to do?

zechariah.1.p3.b6.text: These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise his head; but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations

zechariah.1.p3.b7.text: that have lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter it.
